prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test has shown a clear significant effect.
Predictions were consistently too high in both tests compared to the noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Late Account Authentication Flow: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users can choose a companion before committing to account registration. (why: Sign-in step currently sees drop-off (72.9% conversion) with long mean duration (567s). Deferring auth builds user intent first.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Diagnostic Screen: Add a desktop display check screen prior to waiting to ensure screen overlay permissions are set correctly. (why: Support receives frequent reports about pets failing to show on the desktop or the app failing to open.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Interactive Guide: Introduce a new interactive tutorial screen demonstrating how to control, hide, and talk to your pet. (why: Multiple support tickets express post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Reset and Continuity Banner: Add an explicit persistence hint on sign_in clarifying how authenticating preserves existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Guidance Carousel: Add a tip carousel on photo upload explaining optimal image clarity for custom pet generation. (why: Support receives tickets noting that custom pet generation fails or generates distorted results.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background Preparation Time Estimator: Enable time estimates, progress indicators, and completion notifications during the waiting step. (why: Waiting stage has median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs due to uncertain wait times.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Quick Start Command Copy: Update home_intro text to clearly outline main desktop shortcuts and interaction commands. (why: Users report post-onboarding confusion on how to summon, drag, or interact with their pet.)

scores.note: Defers sign-in to build intent, but structural flow change carries high implementation cost.
Strongly supported by display issues, but adding a new screen historically showed negative lift.
Helps post-onboarding pet control confusion, but requires building a new flow.
Config-only hint backed by 8 support tickets addressing sign-in data confusion.
Targets high drop-off adoption step (60.9%) and addresses custom generation failures.
Addresses severe duration bottleneck (mean 2336s) with clear wait time estimations.
Low cost text update for finish step addressing user confusion on pet shortcuts.
